pages.about.intro: An independent, ad-free, non-commercial fan guide to the 2026 World Cup, built so anyone can answer one question in one click: when is the match, and how do I watch it — free if possible?
pages.about.independence: Independence: not affiliated with FIFA, any federation, broadcaster, or sponsor. No FIFA marks, emblems, mascots, or federation crests are used. Editorial mentions of the tournament are exactly that — editorial.
pages.about.licenses: Licenses: roster text derives from Wikipedia under CC BY-SA 4.0 (pinned revisions, linked on each page). Photos are from Wikimedia Commons under their per-file licenses, attributed where shown (hover ⓘ). Flags are self-hosted Twemoji artwork (CC BY 4.0, pinned v15.1.0). Site code: MIT.
pages.about.honesty: Honesty: every fact carries a source (/sources); unverifiable data shows TBD; live scores come straight from ESPN's official match feed.
pages.about.brandGraphics: Brand graphics: the Golazo 26 mark, doodles, hero art, and share-image compositions are original works of this project (MIT/CC0) — no FIFA or federation marks anywhere. Team banners and flag chips render the country's actual flag from pinned Twemoji artwork (CC BY 4.0, self-hosted), with kit palettes human-audited. Display typeface: Barlow Condensed (OFL).
pages.about.editorialIntegrity: Nsɛm ho nokware: krataa a wɔatwerɛ wɔ ha no yɛ AI a ɛfiri saa site no ankasa data mu na wɔatwerɛ, na wɔasan ahwɛ no wɔ mfidie so, enti din ne nɔma biara a ɛwɔ mu no fi data no mu — biribiara a ɛnyɛ saa no wɔde kyerɛ na wɔgyae krataa no, wɔnkyerɛ no. Team outlook ne match preview no, editor na ɔkenkan na ɔma ho kwan ansa na wɔbɛtwerɛ. Match recap no yɛ automatic bere a whistle no bɔ wie: biara fi confirmed result ne sourced goalscorers mu, na ɛtwerɛ sɛ ɛfa mfidie check no akyi — onni onipa biara wɔ mu. Wɔgyae recap no kosi sɛ wɔanya scorers no, na recap a ɛnfa check no akyi no wɔgyae no, wɔnkyerɛ. Ɛne saa no, AI prediction league yɛ contest a wɔde kyerɛ pefee a AI models anan na wɔbɔ akansi wɔ match biara mu ansa na wɔrebɔ — league no nko ara na wɔde AI picks kyerɛ sɛ ɛte saa, na ɛyɛ anigye a wɔde hyɛ ahantan, ɛnyɛ nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ.
